item.title: This 1967 GT500 Restomod Is Revved Up With 1,200 Twin-Supercharged Horsepower
item.description: This 1967 Shelby GT500 is more than a continuation car. Red River Customs built it into a four-digit, twin-supercharged restomod.

item.title: This 820HP Predator-Powered Fox Is Ready To Hunt
item.description: D&D Performance built an 820hp GT500-powered sleeper. This 1991 Coupe features a 5.4L V8 and a T-56 manual transmission.

item.title: SPE Launches Godzilla-Powered Cobra Replicas Via Snyder Motor Company
item.description: SPE Motorsport expands its performance footprint with turnkey Cobras. These roadsters are built with an SPE Godzilla powertrain.

item.title: Ford Racing’s Raptor T1+ Leaps Its Oracle F1 Cousin On The Streets Of San Francisco
item.description: Ford Racing defied gravity to promote today’s Red Bull Showrun San Francisco. The Blue Oval staged an epic Raptor T1+ jump over an F1 car.

item.title: Project Bosszilla’s LME CNC-Ported Heads Deliver Great Godzilla Gains
item.description: EngineLabs pushed its Godzilla 7.3-liter V8 on the dyno again. LME’s CNC-ported heads delivered big gains on Project Bosszilla.

item.title: BMR Suspension Expands Its Reach With Heidts Acquisition
item.description: BMR Suspension announced the acquisition of Heidts Suspension. The companies will continue serving customers with their familiar products.

item.title: Blueprint’s Blocks Offer A Formidable Foundation For Ford Builds
item.description: Need a heartier foundation for your Ford small-block build? Blueprint Engines created stronger bare 302 and 351 blocks.

item.title: ProCharger Boost Propels Project SC650 To Quick Drag Strip Hits
item.description: Our ProCharged 2024 Mustang build is headed for the finish line. Project SC650 hit the drag strip and put down impressive numbers.

item.title: Coffee & Camshafts Brings Thousands In Giveaways To Mustang Week Texas 2026
item.description: Coffee & Camshafts expands to Mustang Week Texas this April. It takes place at Mainland City Centre in Texas City on Thursday, April 16.

item.title: Limited Shelby Cobra Daytona Coupe Run Celebrates Historic Win
item.description: Shelby Legendary Cars is building more Shelby Cobra Daytona Coupes. These World Championship editions honor a historic FIA GT world title.
